title: Player views match history
description: Select a player, clear the pre-selected opponents, choose opponents with completed match history (first pick shown, then a note that more picks work the same), then open Match History. The walkthrough ends there — single-player rating charts are in View Stats.

steps.title: Players list
steps.body: Tutorial PlayerOnly has matches and rating changes from the seeded completed Round Robin.

steps.title: Open history for the player
steps.body: Tap the scroll icon on the player’s row. That starts history selection with the player chosen (and opponents pre-selected).
steps.actionHint: Click the history icon on the player row

steps.title: History selection
steps.body: The toolbar shows the selected player and how many opponents are checked. Match history uses opponents; rating history needs none.
steps.resultNote: History selection mode is active with the player selected.

steps.title: Deselect All
steps.body: Deselect All clears the pre-checked opponents so you can pick exactly who to compare against.

steps.title: Opponents cleared
steps.body: With 0 opponents selected, you can check the players who have match history with this member.

steps.title: Select an opponent with history
steps.body: Check Alex Rivera — one opponent who has completed matches against Tutorial PlayerOnly.
steps.actionHint: Click the checkbox for Alex Rivera

steps.title: More selections work the same
steps.body: You can check several more opponents the same way. The next screen skips those repeated clicks and shows the result after a few similar selections.

steps.title: Three players selected
steps.body: Tutorial PlayerOnly plus Alex Rivera and Blair Chen — View History will list every match played against those two opponents.
steps.resultNote: 2 opponents selected for match history (remaining picks applied behind the scenes).

steps.title: View History
steps.body: Confirm to open Match History for the selected player against those opponents.

steps.title: Match History
steps.body: Match History lists all matches played against the selected opponents (scores, dates, and rating impact when available). This is the last step of the walkthrough.
steps.resultNote: Match History page shows head-to-head results. Showcase ends here.
